title: Emotion
description: A performant and flexible CSS-in-JS library for React.

data.text: Emotion is a CSS-in-JS library that enables developers to write styles in JavaScript with support for both object and string styles. It offers fast style computation, source maps, and class name hashing for production safety.

data.title: Object Styles with Emotion
data.content: Use the css prop or @emotion/react for object-based styles.

data.title: Object vs String Syntax
data.text: Emotion supports both object styles (great with TypeScript) and tagged template literals (familiar CSS syntax).

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Emotion supports both object and string CSS syntax
Source maps and style composition included
data.takeaway: Emotion is a flexible CSS-in-JS solution with great TypeScript integration.
